prompt: Reduce 3-hexyne to cis-3-hexene using Lindlar catalyst. Draw the alkene.

traps.note: Lindlar gives Z; Na/NH3(l) gives E.

explanation: H2 / Lindlar is a 'poisoned' Pd catalyst that delivers both H's to the SAME face of the alkyne (syn), giving the Z (cis) alkene. For the E isomer, use Na/NH3(l) dissolving-metal reduction.
